findings.reason: §9:339 makes `tests/test_skill_contracts.py` part of every node's gate, so as written the filter node's own gate is unpassable by the route the plan states, and the node must either stall on a red gate or widen that test's regex — a change the plan does not name, though its fence does permit it.
findings.text: `cso-crew-view-filters-live-runs` is told to "widen the Literal to the dispatcher's list" (nineteen views including `plan-review`) and to keep the surface honest by "updat[ing] the view list in `skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md`, which `test_ship_crew_views_match_the_typed_mcp_surface` checks", but that test (`tests/test_skill_contracts.py:1165-1170`) builds its documented set with `re.findall(r'crew\(project, view="([a-z]+)"\)', ship)` and asserts it equals `set(get_args(CrewArgs.model_fields["view"].annotation))`; the regex requires an immediately following `)` and a `[a-z]+` name, so `crew(project, view="plan-review")` (and any other rendering of the hyphenated view) yields no match, making the equality unsatisfiable once the Literal carries `plan-review` — verified against the tree at `ad3f92885`: `CREW_VIEWS` is nineteen names and the only one the canonical form still fails to match is `plan-review` (`crew(project, view="plan-review")` → `[]`)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited path resolves, including `reckon/_mcp_tools.py` (`CrewArgs.view` Literal, ten names), `reckon/mcp_views.py` `CREW_VIEWS` (nineteen names), `reckon/mcp.py` (line 235 `CREW_TOOL_VIEWS = CREW_VIEWS`, `_crew` forwards to `serve_crew_view` at line 2169), `reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:184` (`crew list` refusal answer), `reckon/crew/refusals.py` D20 (`crew ledger`), `reckon/hooks/native_agent_guard.py:3` (docstring names `crew ledger`), `tests/test_crew_surface_parity.py:23` (`CLASSIFICATION_FIELDS`), `tests/test_crew_velocity_cli.py`, `tests/test_findings_read_by_path.py`, and the external guide `/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/imas-ambix/ops/lane-cycle/AGENTS.md:40` (`crew directory --project imas-ambix`).
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each of the four nodes now carries a declared negative control (filter drops `--mine` from `live`; the mover reverts `reckon/mcp_deadlines.py`'s refusal answer; each retiring node points one tombstone at the wrong view), closing the earlier `done_when-1` gap on `cso-list-callers-move-to-crew-view`.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — s9 names no session scratchpad or node-local path; gates run under the run's own log and evidence convention, and the landed record is the project evidence archive.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the node ids and the new test file name (`tests/test_read_verbs_retire_behind_crew_view.py`) are mechanism-named and carry no ticket number, stage label or version tag.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the filter node's stated mechanism (widen the typed `view` Literal to the dispatcher's nineteen names, then "update the view list in `skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md`, which `test_ship_crew_views_match_the_typed_mcp_surface` checks") cannot satisfy that test, because the view it must add is hyphenated and the test's extractor regex only matches `[a-z]+`, so the documented set can never equal the widened Literal.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each node names one deliverable (retire ledger+velocity; give the live view its filters and make the parity case non-tautological; move `crew list` callers; tombstone `crew list`).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s9 declares `depends-on` s7 and s8 (meta `plan-section-depends-on`), all four node write-path sets resolve to existing files, and the serial order is justified by shared files (ledger→filter share `reckon/crew_run_commands.py`, `skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md`, `tests/test_skill_contracts.py`; filter→mover share `skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md`; mover→list-retires share `tests/test_read_verbs_retire_behind_crew_view.py`).
